dossier.summary: Sunvale Health Clinics runs primary care clinics in two towns, with about 35 staff.
dossier.why_now: Opened a third clinic in September.

signals.headline: Sunvale opened a third clinic in September
signals.fact: Our research notes say Sunvale Health Clinics opened a third clinic in September.
signals.means: A third site often means the front desk, scheduling and supply ordering that worked for two clinics start to strain. Small differences between sites tend to show up as patient complaints before they show up in a report.
signals.idea: Pick the three tasks every clinic does daily and write each one as a half-page checklist. Compare how each site does them this month.

data.note: I wrote this one on a single thing, because that was the only change I could back up this month. Nothing here needs an answer. If it is useful, reply and tell me which part. If it is not, tell me and I will stop writing.
